description: Parts of the review.md §2.3 worked example that osp-survey/0.1 still cannot express. The calculate (if()), the quota and the score (as a computed variable) are in survey.json since decisions batch 1; dedicated scores and balanced allocation are deferred to 0.2.

notExpressible.why: deferred to osp-survey/0.2 (decision C2-9); survey.json computes att_score as a computed variable meanwhile: (att1 + att2 + (6 - att3)) / 3
the model has no allocation settings (method, strata, fallback). `between` is implied: both factors are assigned variables set by one assign node

consequences: block 'screenout' is only reached through the quota, so it is not in the flow (warning block.unused)
